::: {.portfolio-landing}

<span class="eyebrow">About the Portfolio</span>

<div class="lead-copy">
This site is a curated collection of selected MBA coursework presented as professional work samples rather than a complete academic archive.
</div>

The portfolio focuses on applied leadership, strategy, healthcare, finance, and analytics. Each publication is adapted from completed academic work and reviewed for public presentation, citation accuracy, and professional context.

::: {.highlight-band}
<span class="eyebrow">Publication Approach</span>

## Practical analysis over assignment volume

The goal is not to publish every assignment. It is to highlight work that demonstrates practical analysis, decision-making, communication, and the ability to connect evidence with real business and healthcare questions.
:::

The complete academic archive—including working drafts, class notes, internal course materials, and other non-public files—is maintained separately from the public portfolio.

:::
